input: Set up a home composting system

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Home Composting System
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to establish a composting system at home to manage organic waste.

questions.title: Do you plan to compost indoors or outdoors?
questions.description: Understand the physical location of the composting setup.

questions.title: How much outdoor space do you have available?
questions.description: Determine space constraints that affect the type and size of composting system.

questions.title: What types of waste will you mainly be composting?
questions.description: Identify the primary inputs such as kitchen scraps, garden waste, or paper.

questions.title: Do you have a budget in mind for this setup?
questions.description: Understand financial constraints to recommend DIY versus purchased solutions.

questions.title: Have you ever composted before at any level?
questions.description: Gauge the user's experience level to tailor the complexity of the plan.

questions.title: What do you plan to use the finished compost for?
questions.description: Clarify the end goal, such as a vegetable garden, houseplants, or lawn care.

questions.title: How quickly do you want usable compost ready?
questions.description: Determine the desired timeline to recommend hot composting, worm bins, or slow cold composting.
